title: PR #111: integration: register all organization repositories and enforce fail-closed audit gates
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: True

## Purpose
Establish one machine-readable integration baseline for all repositories visible in the `A-TownChain-Okosystems` organization.

## Included
- `docs/integration/ATC-ORG-REPOSITORY-INTEGRATION-001.json`: inventory of all 33 observed repositories (26 active, 7 archived), proposed ownership roles, integration anchors, migration questions, residuals and required gates.
- `tools/validate_org_repository_integration.py`: deterministic structural validator. A repository cannot be marked VERIFIED without exact HEAD SHA, tree SHA, CI run/job/step, exit code 0, and log/artifact URL.
- `.github/workflows/org-repository-integration.yml`: PR/main structural gate and report artifact.

## Architecture / SSOT safeguards
- Standalone First, Ecosystem Second.
- The ecosystem remains an integration, architecture, compliance and evidence control plane; it does not become the canonical implementation for component code.
- Canonical VM and algorithm implementation paths remain `a-townchain/components/vm` and `a-townchain/components/algorithm`; the ShivaCore kernel remains under `globus-os/modules/atc-shivacore/kernel`.
- Archived repositories are recorded as historical references, not silently reactivated.
- No repository code was copied, no repository was archived/unarchived, no CI gate was weakened, and no PR was merged.

## Explicit residuals
- The `a-townchain-os` versus `a-townchain-ecosystem` orchestration/control-plane boundary needs reconciliation against the latest approved architecture.
- `atc-node`, `atc-contracts`, and `atc-zkp` are unarchived although the existing registry describes migrations into `a-townchain`; exact subtree/source SHA and KEEP/SYNC/ARCHIVE decisions remain open.
- `atc-sdk` ownership and migration state remain to be verified.
- This PR records the observed inventory; it does not assert that all repository integrations, APIs, tests, standards checks, or CI runs are verified.

## Merge policy
Draft until the exact-SHA workflow passes and the ownership/migration residuals are reviewed. No automatic merge.
